decision.reasoning_trace: The consideration set was chosen to reflect a variety of use cases: ultra-portable (JBL), high-value mid-range (Raymate), luxury portable (Bang & Olufsen), rugged high-power (Bogasing), and premium home audio (Edifier). I selected the JBL Clip 3 as the final choice because it is a highly proven product with a 4.7 rating and over 68,000 reviews. Its combination of waterproof durability, the integrated carabiner design, and a reasonable price point of $54.95 makes it a more practical and reliable purchase than the more expensive luxury options or the higher-powered but less portable alternatives.
